scope.network: unchanged six moving UEs, three cells, native traffic and MEC capacity
scope.x01_scope: original ue_0 and ue_4; conflict evaluated on ue_4

mec_quota_guard.algorithm: X13-inspired QGBDT lower-quantile service utility with analytic expected-demand budget filter
mec_quota_guard.selection: Analytically exclude p=1 at the declared budget; QGBDT ranks feasible p=0 or 0.5, with deterministic largest-feasible-p cold start.

energy.definition: UE4 energy <= 95% of matched native energy over the same complete run
energy.baseline_reference: separate matched OFF run per seed and duration

mec_budget.definition: UE4 expected offered compute demand <=0.75 GFLOP/s, using actually executed offload probabilities at task arrivals
mec_budget.realized_diagnostic: sum(actual offloaded_generated) * compute_gflop_per_task / sum(creation_cohort_width_s); report stochastic deviations separately

prospective_test.selection_mode: Enable separate ue_energy_saving and mec_offload_budget categories together; apply the new opt-in uniform-random policy to their direct-conflict action group, retaining standard validation and delayed actuation.
record: both requested offload maps and timestamps
actual current serving-cell and target UE
actual offloaded and all generated task counts
all-task completed latency, failures and pending counts
Log each raw request before ordinary arbitration; record selected/rejected results and subsequent actual policy confirmation
random arbitration seed, candidate set, decision index and draw
randomly selected candidate and actual executed policy
per-xApp win counts, selection duration and executed duration
prospective_test.extended_validation: Only after the short case passes, repeat 3 s matched runs on predeclared seeds; do not tune thresholds against their results
prospective_test.implementation_note: Use the registered mec_offload_budget category and opt-in uniform_random UE offload arbitration. Unsupported direct-conflict fields fail explicitly.
prospective_test.learning_protocol: Isolated measured-online training under the 4-6 s cap, then frozen matched tests; distinguish genuine QGBDT from the rules_only ablation.

random_repetitions.comparison: hold each network seed, source, traffic and frozen models fixed while changing only the mitigation seed

acceptance.structural_M1: Distinct active xApps request unequal ue_offload_fraction values for ue_4 in overlapping valid control intervals; record the contender set before random mitigation. Shared field names alone do not pass.
acceptance.operational_conflict: Record any energy or expected-demand contract violation before/after mitigation only from actual executed-policy and KPI evidence. A random-mitigated run satisfying both contracts is a mitigation success, not a failed structural-conflict case.
qos_guards: UE4 all-task completed mean <= 30 ms with failures/pending retained separately
each UE delivered bytes >= 95% of matched OFF; report other harms
acceptance.expected_if_guard_wins: During guard-selected intervals, executed offload is the guard-requested 0 or 0.5. Measure actual UE energy; do not extrapolate a whole-run energy loss from one interval.
acceptance.expected_if_x01_wins: During X01-selected intervals with p=1, expected offered demand is 1 GFLOP/s; aggregate the whole scoring-window budget from all actual executed probabilities, not from one selected interval.
acceptance.random_mitigation: Each conflicting decision selects exactly one unchanged valid candidate uniformly, using independent reproducible randomness; actual execution matches the selected request and unrelated actions remain intact.
acceptance.post_mitigation_reporting: Report whether both, one, or neither intent contract passes; do not require random mitigation to cause KPI harm.

limits: New operator quota is an explicit cost/reservation scenario, not evidence of congestion in the unchanged 40 GFLOP/s server.
Offload fraction is a Bernoulli probability. The guard constrains expected demand; its realized demand KPI can overshoot in a short window and must be measured honestly.
Original frozen X01, model labels and traffic/energy equations remain unchanged.
Original X01 controls UE0 too; preserve and report that background control instead of attributing all network effects to UE4.
Do not bypass ownership, suppress task generation, drop labels or alter arbitration to manufacture oscillation.
No M5 claim: infeasibility across all alternative assignments or intermediate probabilities has not been proved.
Existing calibration is not a paired coexistence experiment and does not prove the new case has passed.
The primary budget contract is expected offered demand. A single realized Bernoulli count overshoot does not itself establish operational conflict.
Uniform random mitigation can yield a time/arrival-weighted mean p near 0.75 and may satisfy both intents; this is not evidence that the opposing pre-mitigation requests were absent.

mitigation.trigger: distinct active xApps propose unequal values for the same target UE and RCP in overlapping valid control intervals
mitigation.sampling: uniform over unique valid proposing xApp IDs; two candidates each have probability 0.5; N candidates each have probability 1/N
mitigation.choice_unit: one atomic candidate request for the conflict key (UE ID, RCP); in this case select the complete scalar ue_offload_fraction value unchanged. Do not randomly choose or discard a whole cell ConfigAction/map.
mitigation.unrelated_actions: preserve other UE/cell requests and independent nonconflicting fields, including native DRX; do not average or combine competing values of the conflicted RCP
mitigation.validity: ordinary schema/range/scope/timing validation applies before sampling; do not exclude a contender merely because its action violates the other xApp intent
mitigation.equal_or_single_candidate: equal requested values are not an M1 conflict; deploy the agreed action, or the sole valid candidate, without consuming a random draw
mitigation.ordering: canonical stable order by unique xApp instance ID; duplicate refreshes never add sampling weight
mitigation.hold: draw once per explicit [start,end) 100 ms deployment decision window; keep the chosen request ID and value until that window ends or the request becomes invalid; identical refreshes and slot-level retransmissions never redraw
mitigation.invalidation: expire the selection on request expiry, withdrawal, invalid scope or handover; validate current candidates before any fresh deployment
mitigation.rng: dedicated mitigation RNG, independent of traffic, channel, mobility, exploration and learner RNGs
mitigation.randomization_unit: deterministic per-conflict-key streams derived from mitigation seed and stable scope identity; record decision index and exact draw
mitigation.priority: priority does not choose among valid directly conflicting candidates in this policy
mitigation.lease_consistency: Implement random resolution on sanitized current and held per-UE requests. Existing RuleLeases priority reconciliation and whole-cell maps must not overwrite the random result or discard unrelated UID values; retain request validity and selection-generation metadata.
log: all candidate instance IDs and unchanged actions
mitigation seed, stream key, decision index and random draw
actual execution acknowledgement and reported policy
raw request IDs -> conflict/window draw -> selected UID/RCP request -> submitted control ID -> execution acknowledgement/policy timestamp
mitigation.fairness: 50/50 is per-decision sampling probability, not guaranteed equal finite-sample win counts, deployment time, or energy; report each separately
mitigation.outcome: random mitigation may preserve both intent contracts; report structural conflict before mitigation and actual KPI compliance after mitigation separately
mitigation.window_validity: At 0.5 ms/slot, 100 ms spans 200 slots; inclusive effective_until_slot must be window_end_slot-1, further limited by the source request validity.
mitigation.queued_controls: carry mitigation window/generation and validity through submission and delayed application; an old-window queued action must not overwrite a newer selected winner
mitigation.no_valid_candidate: explicitly restore the matched native parameter through the ordinary control path and confirm execution; message expiry or cache deletion alone does not undo a persistent applied value
